entities.summary: The Arboretum de Pézanin or Arboretum Domanial de Pézanin is an arboretum located in Dompierre-les-Ormes, Saône-et-Loire, Bourgogne, France. It is one of the oldest and richest forest collections in France, with trees and plants from all around the world.
